Upstream KNUQ also at 51.8°F. Airmass curve peaks at 57.2°F but that assumes clearing — no clearing mechanism visible. Run_max 55.4°F already. Forecasts cluster 57-60°F requiring full clearing of this rain/overcast system. Deck fate: cloud bases NOT rising (held BKN600-900 through the hour). This is a cold marine rain event suppressing temps well below 55°F ceiling. Position needs daily max >55°F; evidence strongly argues for suppression. This is an argument AGAINST the position.
